title: Homogeneous quadratic PCPP system
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, each specified by a coefficient matrix and a right-hand side. The associated Boolean proof-checking system has proof length $2^n+2^{n^2}$ and uses four queries; its verifier is the homogeneous quadratic proof tester for $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $L$ of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
